maddeler.e:
نتهاجر (form VI)
# نَتَهَاجَرُ (natahājaru) /na.ta.haː.d͡ʒa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَهَاجَرَ (tahājara)
# نَتَهَاجَرَ (natahājara) /na.ta.haː.d͡ʒa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَهَاجَرَ (tahājara)
# نَتَهَاجَرْ (natahājar) /na.ta.haː.d͡ʒar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَهَاجَرَ (tahājara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
